_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Home#001.src: Is there anything I can do for you today?

A Journey Home#002.src: ...something's prickling at the back of your mind. Weren't you asleep like this when you first arrived, too?
A Journey Home#002.dst: ...머릿속 한구석이 따끔거립니다. 처음 도착했을 때도 이렇게 잠들어 있지 않았던가요?

A Journey Home#004.src: Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
A Journey Home#004.dst: 당신이 처음 Wynn에 도착한 곳 근처를 탐험하세요.

A Journey Home#006.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#007.src: This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
A Journey Home#007.dst: 이 일은 불가능해!! 내가 왜 여기 있는 거야?!
A Journey Home#007.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#008.src: Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I- It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
A Journey Home#008.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#009.src: This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
A Journey Home#009.dst: 이, 이 상황은 제 직급으로 감당할 일이 절대 아니에요! 어떻게 처리해야 할지 모르겠어요...
A Journey Home#009.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#010.src: Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
A Journey Home#010.dst: 그만하죠, 저, 어, 그래요. 뭐가 필요하세요?
A Journey Home#010.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#011.src: Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
A Journey Home#011.dst: 아. 아 이런. 어, 저, 그게, 그건 좀 곤란할 것 같네요. 대체 국경에서 무슨 일을 하시려고요?
A Journey Home#011.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#012.src: I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and
A Journey Home#012.dst: 거기서 무슨 볼일이 있는지 상상이 안 가지만, 뭐든 기다려야 해요! 이 Corkus 드릴은 작동을 안 하고, Paxon은 갇혔고,
A Journey Home#012.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#013.src: Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
A Journey Home#013.dst: 저기, 저... 짜증 내서 죄송해요. 전 군사 작전 훈련을 받았지, 붕괴 현장 정리는 아니에요. 근데 다른 사람이 없었어요!
A Journey Home#013.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#014.src: Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
A Journey Home#014.dst: 고용한 폭파 전문가마저 갇혔으니, 다 그냥, 다 틀어지고 있고 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어요.
A Journey Home#014.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#015.src: You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
A Journey Home#015.dst: 저기 새 입구 보이죠? 전문가 Paxon이 제가 이 고물 기계를 붙잡고 있던 만큼이나 오래 저 안에 있어요.
A Journey Home#015.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#016.src: If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
A Journey Home#016.dst: 전문가보다 잘할 자신이 있으면 가서 얘기해 보세요. 그래도 원래 계획은 취소하셔야 할 거예요.
A Journey Home#016.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#017.src: Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#018.src: If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
A Journey Home#018.dst: 정말 국경에 가야 한다면, 새 동굴 입구에 있는 Paxon과 얘기하는 게 제일 좋아요.
A Journey Home#018.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#019.src: But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
A Journey Home#019.dst: 하지만 전문가니까, 볼일은 미루셔야 할 거예요. 정말, 정말 죄송해요!
A Journey Home#019.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#020.src: Oh no, not another one I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it
A Journey Home#020.dst: 아 이런, 또 한 명이야 계급이 뭐든 상관없어, 당신 요구는 불가능해! 나라도 그건
A Journey Home#020.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#021.src: Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
A Journey Home#021.dst: 잠깐, 당신은 그쪽 사람이... 그냥 평범한 병사네. 그냥 여길 지나가려는 거지?
A Journey Home#021.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#022.src: May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
A Journey Home#022.dst: 지금 포기하는 게 나아! 안 돼. 절대로. 시간 낭비야, 정확히 왜 그런지 말해 주지.
A Journey Home#022.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#023.src: You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off these explosives at it, it'd open a path.
A Journey Home#023.dst: 저기 파란 바위 보여? 약점이야. 거기서 폭약을 터뜨릴 수 있으면 길이 열릴 거야.
A Journey Home#023.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#024.src: They're gone. Hurry down the path!

A Journey Home#025.src: But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
A Journey Home#025.dst: 그런데 여기 세워진 구조물이 전부 너무 중요해서 하나라도 부서지거나 옮겨지면 안 된대!
A Journey Home#025.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#026.src: And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
A Journey Home#026.dst: 게다가 중위가 드릴을 고치는 동안 날 '감독'하겠다고 기폭 장치는 무조건 여기 있어야 한대.
A Journey Home#026.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#027.src: So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
A Journey Home#027.dst: 그러니까 한정된 폭약을 저 돌까지 줄줄이 연결해야 해, 구조물은 하나도 안 터뜨리고!
A Journey Home#027.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#028.src: I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
A Journey Home#028.dst: 몇 시간째 해 봤는데 전혀 진전이 없어! 나 이 분야 최고 중 하나라고! 말도 안 돼!!
A Journey Home#028.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#029.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you really should just go.
A Journey Home#029.dst: 시간 낭비하고 싶으면, 여기 내 폭약 재고야. 마음대로 해 봐, 그래도 그냥 가는 게 좋을 거야.
A Journey Home#029.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#030.src: Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.

A Journey Home#031.src: Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
A Journey Home#031.dst: 아직도 하고 있어? 뭐, 다시 설명해 줘? 딱히 할 일도 없으니까.
A Journey Home#031.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#032.src: So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
A Journey Home#032.dst: 파란 바위는 폭약으로 깨질 만큼 무르거든. 그런데 기폭 장치가 여기 묶여 있어.
A Journey Home#032.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#033.src: So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
A Journey Home#033.dst: 그러니 TNT Placer로 기폭 장치에서부터 폭발을 줄줄이 이어야 해, 천막이나 상자, 벽은 하나도 안 터뜨리고.
A Journey Home#033.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#034.src: You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
A Journey Home#034.dst: 설치한 TNT를 바라보면 폭발 범위도 볼 수 있어.
A Journey Home#034.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#035.src: But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
A Journey Home#035.dst: 하지만 구조물 사이 틈이 저렇게 좁아서야, 절대 안 될 거야.
A Journey Home#035.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#036.src: Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
A Journey Home#036.dst: 말했듯이, 그냥 성으로 슬슬 돌아가는 게 좋을 거야. 나도 못 하는데 당신이 더 잘할 것 같진 않거든.
A Journey Home#036.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#039.src: Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
A Journey Home#039.dst: 멈춰라! 어디서 왔지? 이 너머에 붕괴가 있지 않았나?
A Journey Home#039.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#040.src: A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
A Journey Home#040.dst: 새 길이라고? 여기 뒤쪽에 볼일이 있을 줄은 몰랐지만, 고맙지 않다고는 않겠네.
A Journey Home#040.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#041.src: It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
A Journey Home#041.dst: 저기 grook 둥지까지 무너뜨렸어. 며칠째 야전 식량으로 버티고 있지. 그래서 어디로 가나?
A Journey Home#041.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#042.src: The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
A Journey Home#042.dst: 국경? 거기로 간다면 중요한 공무겠지. 그래도 기다려야 할지도 몰라.
A Journey Home#042.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#043.src: The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
A Journey Home#043.dst: 다리 수리가 좀 엉터리였거든. 자네 무게를 못 버틸 수도 있어. 붕괴가 치워졌으니 제대로 고칠 수 있을지도...
A Journey Home#043.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#044.src: But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
A Journey Home#044.dst: 하지만 시간이 걸릴 거야. 나라면 돌아가겠네 무슨 볼일이든 목숨만큼 가치 있진 않으니까.
A Journey Home#044.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#046.src: Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
A Journey Home#046.dst: 그러고 보니 자네 낯이 익은 것 같군. 이 일을 하면서 드문 일이지.
A Journey Home#046.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#047.src: Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
A Journey Home#047.dst: 할 일이 정말 그만한 가치가 있나? 저 다리는 지독하게 흔들려. 자네를 잃고 싶진 않네.
A Journey Home#047.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#048.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#049.src: Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
A Journey Home#049.dst: 이봐, 거기! 지나가기 전에 나랑 얘기 좀 하지.
A Journey Home#049.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#050.src: Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
A Journey Home#050.dst: 이봐, 너! 먼저 나랑 얘기해, 신병!
A Journey Home#050.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#051.src: Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
A Journey Home#051.dst: 오든 가든, 병사를 붙잡아서 장비를 갖췄는지 확인한 뒤 보내라는 엄명을 받았다.
A Journey Home#051.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#052.src: No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
A Journey Home#052.dst: 예외는 없다, 어떤 이유로도. 특히 강 건너 붕괴 이후로는!
A Journey Home#052.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#053.src: Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
A Journey Home#053.dst: 목숨보다 중요한 건 없고, 제대로 무장 안 하고 가면 목숨을 잃을 수도 있어!
A Journey Home#053.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#054.src: Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#054.dst: 자, 이 장비가 규정에 맞는지 한번 보자.
A Journey Home#054.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#055.src: Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
A Journey Home#055.dst: 흠... 아, 그래, 온통 닳았군... 갑옷은 광도 안 냈고... 무기는 당장이라도 부서질 것 같고...
A Journey Home#055.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#056.src: I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
A Journey Home#056.dst: 이런 녹슨 잡동사니로 여기까지 온 게 놀랍군! 이래서는 몸을 못 지킨다!
A Journey Home#056.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#057.src: Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
A Journey Home#057.dst: 잘 들어, 바로 저 동굴에 전리품 상자가 있으니 들어가서 제대로 된 장비를 챙겨 와.
A Journey Home#057.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#058.src: ...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
A Journey Home#058.dst: ...그래? 그럼 저 앞을 다시 한번 봐 두는 게 좋겠군.
A Journey Home#058.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#059.src: See? Now no more guff about levels you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
A Journey Home#059.dst: 봤지? 이제 레벨 타령은 그만 제대로 무장하든지, 못 지나가든지다! 목숨 걸게 두진 않겠다.
A Journey Home#059.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#060.src: You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
A Journey Home#060.dst: 동굴엔 좋은 물건이 있어, 바로 내 옆에 있는 것처럼. 그러니 어서 가.
A Journey Home#060.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#061.src: Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
A Journey Home#061.dst: 말했듯이, 오든 가든이다. 무슨 일이 있어도 떠나기 전에 여기 동굴을 뒤져서 무장해.
A Journey Home#061.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#062.src: Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
A Journey Home#062.dst: 좋아. 저 동굴에 전리품 상자가 있으니 필요한 건 다 찾을 거다. 어서 가!
A Journey Home#062.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#063.src: Explore the cave to find some loot.

A Journey Home#064.src: Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
A Journey Home#064.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#065.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#066.src: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#066.dst: 그거면 됐어. 저 갑옷은 바로 저기 Item Identifier에게 가져가면 되고, 감정되면 입을 수 있어.
A Journey Home#066.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#067.src: Though... since you seem to be heading back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
A Journey Home#067.dst: 그런데... 국경 쪽으로 돌아가는 것 같은데... 이유를 물어야겠군. 흔한 일이 아니야. {p}(으)로 돌아가는 게 좋을 거다.
A Journey Home#067.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#068.src: If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
A Journey Home#068.dst: 다른 신병들이 반대로 가는 널 보면 헷갈리거나 사기가 꺾일 수 있어. 그런 위험은 피하고 싶겠지?
A Journey Home#068.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#069.src: Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
A Journey Home#069.dst: 하려는 일이 정말 그만한 가치가 있나? 그냥 마을로 돌아가는 게 좋겠어.
A Journey Home#069.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#070.src: Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.

A Journey Home#071.src: ...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
A Journey Home#071.dst: ...전쟁 때문에 Fruma 병사를 모집해 왔대. 저쪽 상황이 정말 나쁜가 봐. 불안해...
A Journey Home#071.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#072.src: Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
A Journey Home#072.dst: 걸어 다니는 시체를 얕볼 생각은 없지만, 전부 암울하기만 하진 않겠지?
A Journey Home#072.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#073.src: I suppose we'll see once we pass this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
A Journey Home#073.dst: 이 관문을 지나면 알게 되겠지. 여기가 국경이야... 심호흡, 심호흡...
A Journey Home#073.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#074.src: ...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
A Journey Home#074.dst: ...Wynn에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어? 난 브리핑을 못 받았어.
A Journey Home#074.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#075.src: I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...and R?
A Journey Home#075.dst: 소문은 기억나... 위대한 영웅이 있다던데. 이름이... R로 시작했나?
A Journey Home#075.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#076.src: We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
A Journey Home#076.dst: 기회 되는 대로 꼭 물어보자. 전쟁에선 정보가 핵심이니까.
A Journey Home#076.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#077.src: ...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
A Journey Home#077.dst: ...형편없는 마부야. 안됐긴 한데, 항상 그 바위에 부딪힌다잖아. 내가 보기엔 자기 잘못이야.
A Journey Home#077.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#078.src: I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
A Journey Home#078.dst: 바퀴보다 밥 생각이 더 나. 며칠은 굶은 기분이야. 걷는 길이 짧았으면...
A Journey Home#078.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#079.src: Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
A Journey Home#079.dst: 마부가 좀 더 유능했으면 빈속으로 이렇게 멀리 안 걸었겠지! 서두르자, 가서 거하게 먹게, 응?
A Journey Home#079.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#080.src: Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
A Journey Home#080.dst: 잠깐, 저건 누구야? 왜 국경 쪽에서 오는 거지??
A Journey Home#080.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#082.src: ...and that's the last of them for today.
A Journey Home#082.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#083.src: Lot of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
A Journey Home#083.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#084.src: Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
A Journey Home#084.dst: 똑같은 망할 바위... 똑같은 망할 대사. 언젠가 좀 바꾸게 해 주려나. 매번 귀찮아...
A Journey Home#084.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#085.src: And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
A Journey Home#085.dst: 뭐, 그건 그렇다 치고. 이제 가 볼까... 내가 고른 집으로. 거기까진 골칫거리가 못 따라오지.
A Journey Home#085.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#087.src: Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
A Journey Home#087.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#088.src: Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
A Journey Home#088.dst: 꽤 약은 줄 알았지. 내가 뒤에 남아서 지켜보는 것도 못 봤지? 내가 어제 태어난 줄 알아?
A Journey Home#088.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#089.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#089.dst: 들어 봐, 이런 일이 처음은 아니야 있잖아. 누군가 궁금해서 온 길을 되짚어 오는 거.
A Journey Home#089.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#090.src: If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
A Journey Home#090.dst: 눈치 못 챘다면, 이건 전부 편도 여행이야. 다리, 붕괴, 다들 널 말리려던 것까지.
A Journey Home#090.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#091.src: It's not wise to be here- After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
A Journey Home#091.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#092.src: So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching right back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
A Journey Home#092.dst: 그러니까... 선택지는 둘이야, 친구. 이 일은 우리끼리 없던 걸로 할 수 있어. 진짜로. {p}(으)로 곧장 돌아가면 입 다물고 있지.
A Journey Home#092.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#093.src: Alas, I am afraid my hands are quite tied here. There is little I can do- you recall what I said in the meeting.
A Journey Home#093.dst: 아아, 유감스럽게도 이 일엔 손을 쓸 수가 없습니다. 제가 할 수 있는 건 별로 없어요- 회의에서 한 말 기억하시죠.

A Journey Home#094.src: Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though it's leaving soon.
A Journey Home#094.dst: 아니면 위험하게 살아 보든가, 날 따라 {p}행 열차에 타. 빨리 정하는 게 좋을 거야, 곧 출발하거든.
A Journey Home#094.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#095.src: If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
A Journey Home#095.dst: 객차에서 널 보게 되면, 뭐... 그걸로 끝이고, 어떻게 되는지 지켜보는 수밖에 없지.
A Journey Home#095.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#096.src: Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#097.src: Last chance to back out. This your choice?
A Journey Home#097.dst: 물러설 마지막 기회야. 이게 네 선택이야?
A Journey Home#097.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#098.src: Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
A Journey Home#098.dst: 그럼 {p}까지 먼 길 걸어서 돌아가는 게 좋을 거야.
A Journey Home#098.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#102.src: You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
A Journey Home#102.dst: 호기심이 고양이를 죽인다는 말 알지. 만족하면 고양이가 되살아난다고 믿는 타입인가?
A Journey Home#102.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#103.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#103.dst: 자, '고양이 양반', 네가 찾은 건 크림이 아니라 사냥개다.
A Journey Home#103.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#104.src: Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
A Journey Home#104.dst: Fruma 침입자, 너를 체포한다! 이제 걸어!
A Journey Home#104.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#105.src: You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
A Journey Home#105.dst: 정말 그 마부가 네 편이라고 생각했나, 침입자? 어리석긴. 그만둘 기회를 몇 번이고 줬는데, 결국 여기 왔군. 가자.
A Journey Home#105.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#107.src: I have urgent news to report from the gate.
A Journey Home#107.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#108.src: If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
A Journey Home#108.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#109.src: Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
A Journey Home#109.dst: 병사들! 침입자를 붙잡아 둬라. 너희를 전적으로 믿는다.
A Journey Home#109.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#113.src: Anythin' I can help you with?
A Journey Home#113.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#114.src: Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
A Journey Home#114.dst: 흠. 뭐 해될 건 없겠지. 그래도 조심하쇼, 알겠소?
A Journey Home#114.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#115.src: This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
A Journey Home#115.dst: 여긴 우리 집이오. 뭐라도 망쳐 놓으면 곱게 안 넘어갈 거요, 알겠소?
A Journey Home#115.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#116.src: ...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
A Journey Home#116.dst: ...이것저것 따지면 그럭저럭 지내오. 날씨도 좋고. 축제도 곧 열리고.
A Journey Home#116.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#117.src: But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
A Journey Home#117.dst: 하지만 그건 우리 알 바 아니오. 더 필요한 게 없으면 이만 가 주시오.
A Journey Home#117.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#118.src: Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
A Journey Home#118.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#119.src: Hmm? And who may you be?
A Journey Home#119.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#120.src: Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
A Journey Home#120.dst: 호오, 뭐 어쩔 수 없죠. 뭘 도와드릴까요?
A Journey Home#120.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#121.src: Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
A Journey Home#121.dst: 아, 이런저런 금속 세공 일을 마무리하고 있어요. 여기는 늘 뭔가 교체하거나 손봐야 할 게 있는 것 같아서요...
A Journey Home#121.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#122.src: Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
A Journey Home#122.dst: 그래도 전문가는 절대 아니에요! 하지만 도구는 충분히 다룰 줄 알고, 이 일엔 그거면 돼요.
A Journey Home#122.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#123.src: Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
A Journey Home#123.dst: 잘 가요, 낯선 분! 무사히 집에 돌아가길 바라요.
A Journey Home#123.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#000~1.src: What is this place? Such technology, you can hardly imagine how it was made.
A Journey Home#000~1.dst: 여긴 대체 어디지? 이런 기술이라니, 어떻게 만들었는지 상상조차 안 돼.

A Journey Home#001~1.src: The caravan driver seems to have disappeared... maybe you can find something if you look in some of mechanized carriages?
A Journey Home#001~1.dst: 마차 몰이꾼이 사라진 것 같다... 기계 마차 몇 대를 뒤져 보면 뭔가 찾을 수 있을지도?

A Journey Home#002~1.src: {p}'s relations with Fruma exclusively consist of the generous batches of recruits sent to fight the corruption here in Wynn.
A Journey Home#002~1.dst: {p}와(과) Fruma의 관계는 오로지 Wynn에서 타락과 싸우라고 넉넉히 보내 주는 신병들뿐이다.

A Journey Home#003~1.src: They've shut you out. There's no way in from here... But what if you went back the way
A Journey Home#003~1.dst: 그들이 너를 막아 버렸다. 여기서는 들어갈 길이 없다... 하지만 왔던 길로 되돌아간다면

A Journey Home#004~1.src: ...Ah. I see. So I suppose...things must not have gone well. Have all the others returned?
A Journey Home#004~1.dst: ...아. 그렇군. 그렇다면... 일이 잘 풀리지 않았나 보군. 다른 이들은 모두 돌아왔나?

A Journey Home#034~1.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you should really just go.
A Journey Home#034~1.dst: 시간 낭비하고 싶으면, 여기 내 폭발물 재고가 있어. 마음대로 해 봐도 되지만, 그냥 가는 게 좋을 거야.
A Journey Home#034~1.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#059~1.src: Well, let me take a look at it and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#059~1.dst: 자, 어디 한번 보고 규정에 맞는지 확인해 보지.
A Journey Home#059~1.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#095~1.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened- Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#095~1.dst: 들어 봐, 이런 일이 처음은 아니야- 알잖아. 누군가 궁금해져서 왔던 길을 되짚어 가는 거.
A Journey Home#095~1.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#096~1.src: ...I will make only one demand of you. Whatever happens...come back alive.
A Journey Home#096~1.dst: ...너에게 단 하나만 요구하마. 무슨 일이 있어도... 살아서 돌아와라.

A Journey Home#099~1.src: He's dead asleep. You could probably ring a church bell an inch above his head and he'd stay unconscious.
A Journey Home#099~1.dst: 곯아떨어졌다. 머리 바로 위에서 교회 종을 울려도 깨지 않을 것 같다.

A Journey Home#100~1.src: That looks like the stuff. See? That wasn't so hard. Alright, now!
A Journey Home#100~1.dst: 그거 맞는 것 같네. 봐? 그렇게 어렵지 않았지. 좋아, 이제!

A Journey Home#112~1.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream- just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#112~1.dst: 자, '야옹이', 크림은 못 찾았네- 사냥개들만 찾았지.
A Journey Home#112~1.speaker: Fruman Guard
